business_summary: Anhui Chaoyue Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. engages in incineration, landfill, physical and chemical treatment, comprehensive utilization of industrial and medical hazardous waste, and dismantling and sales of waste electrical and electronic products and electronic waste dismantling subsidies. Anhui Chaoyue Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2009 and is based in Chuzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Anhui Chaoyue Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd.는 소각, 매립, 물리적 및 화학적 처리, 산업 및 의료 위험 폐기물의 종합적인 활용, 전기 및 전자 폐기물 해체 및 판매, 전자 폐기물 해체 보조금 서비스를 제공합니다. Anhui Chaoyue Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd.는 2009년에 설립되었으며 중국 추저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
